single_change: Interpret each intent as a preference over all safe executable actions instead of an exact action-category requirement. Hold only when no safe territorial, infrastructure, or physical action exists.
hypothesis: Intent preferences will preserve the planner's high-level choice without freezing when its ideal action is temporarily unavailable. In particular, consolidate should prefer infrastructure but continue safe territorial growth when no build or upgrade is offered.

executor_contract.expand: prefer neutral territory, then infrastructure, then safe physical force
executor_contract.consolidate: prefer infrastructure, then safe neutral growth, then safe physical force
executor_contract.convert: prefer coherent physical force, then safe neutral growth, then infrastructure
executor_contract.target_continuity: unchanged; continue the prior safe physical target while a legal action remains
executor_contract.unavailable_preference: choose the next safe outcome-aligned action rather than hold
executor_contract.hold: only when no safe executable action in the three outcome families exists

authorized_next_action: Implement, test, and locally qualify intent preferences. No upload, hosted request, submission, membership change, or champion change is authorized by this preregistration alone.
